'''Baradin Bay''' is a portion of the [[Great Sea]] off the west coast of central [[Eastern Kingdoms]], mostly noted by travelers on the northwestern coast of the [[Wetlands]] north of [[Menethil Harbor]]. It spans the coast from [[Menethil Harbor]] all the way to [[Lordaeron]] in the north. Important settlements located on its coast include: [[Menethil Harbor]], [[Stromgarde Keep]], [[Southshore]], and [[Ravenshire]].

==Notes and trivia==
* The murloc hovels in the [[Wetlands]] have a high concentration of junk that you can [[Fishing|fish]].
* It is stated that between [[Hasic]] and Khaz Modan there is only water and the island of Tol Barad,<ref>''[[Day of the Dragon]]'', pg. 121</ref> meaning it is located on Baradin Bay's Lordaeronian coast.
* The name "Baradin Bay", first seen in ''World of Warcraft'', was probably named as such by the designers because of the previous appearance of the island of [[Tol Barad]] in ''Warcraft II''. Tol Barad was originally depicted in the yet to be named bay.
